verdict.rationale: Secureframe documents a public REST API with a full OpenAPI 3.0 spec, says the API can connect to any existing object in the account, and offers an MCP server for querying and updating compliance data. However, nothing explicitly claims that every UI action (e.g., Trust Center customization, policy editing, access-review decisions) is exposed via the API, so UI parity is implied rather than demonstrated. missing for 10: explicit API/UI parity statement or endpoint-coverage evidence for UI workflows like Trust Center, policy editor and access reviews, independent or hands-on corroboration of coverage breadth

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: Use Secureframe’s API to connect to any existing object in your Secureframe account.

Secureframe exposes a REST API for use by customers, partners, and community developers. The Secureframe API utilizes resource-oriented endpoints and returns requests in the form of standard JSON responses
The Secureframe MCP server allows you to access and manage your Secureframe data — controls, tests, vendors, frameworks, risks, and more — as Model Context Protocol tools.
Connect an AI assistant to your Secureframe workspace and query or update your compliance data through the Model Context Protocol (MCP).
